recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-24096 unless Pharmacy later reopens the separate FHIR-24100 workflow decision to restore MedicationAdministration instantiation elements.
issue_request: FHIR-24096 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy QA issue, raised against STU3 and applied for R5, asking to add RIM mappings for MedicationAdministration.instantiatesUri and MedicationAdministration.recorded and to ensure MedicationAdministration.status uses an internally defined medication-admin-status code system.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by Jira-tagged commit 8c940464f5f46e1b990e93df032065d1717847de, merged by f0db919750, which changed the medication-admin-status CodeSystem and ValueSet source URLs from terminology.hl7.org to the core FHIR code system and adjusted the MedicationAdministration spreadsheet source carrying the requested mappings. Later source refactoring converted the spreadsheet content into structuredefinition-MedicationAdministration.xml.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition already has a RIM map for MedicationAdministration.recorded, and the current CodeSystem and ValueSet sources use http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medication-admin-status. Later Published/Persuasive issue FHIR-24100 removed the MedicationAdministration instantiates attributes, and commit ece63351c6107ee2d837bd8bdc64871ad186dc4c removed both instantiatesCanonical and instantiatesUri after they had RIM mappings.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Re-adding a RIM mapping for the removed MedicationAdministration.instantiatesUri element would be wrong, and the current active source already contains the recorded RIM mapping and internal medication-admin-status code system.

related_jiras.note: Published Pharmacy workflow review removed MedicationAdministration instantiates attributes, making the old FHIR-24096 instantiatesUri mapping target out of current build scope.
